summary: Tested AI Photo Review grid APIs (list/pending filter/approve/main/delete/redo), story-photo settings, post_story_photo (direct call), Online tab AI personas, and Admin 'AI Photos' UI. 2 real Gemini generations used (1 redo via API, 1 post_story_photo direct). All core flows work. One bug: PUT /api/admin/ai-story-photos with non-numeric every_days returns 500. Data restored (Priya Sharma & Ananya Patel photos/profile_picture/photos_approved), ai_story_photos reset to disabled/4.

minor.issue: every_days='abc' (or null) -> int() ValueError -> 500. Wrap in try/except and return 400.
Returns {started:true} for non-existent / non-AI profile id (no 404 check); task silently no-ops.

AI personas get last_active refreshed every 5 min by keep_ai_profiles_online and query sorts by last_active desc with limit 20 -> result was 20/20 AI (102 AI online). Real active users will be crowded out of the Online tab whenever >20 AIs are online. Also AI personas with 0 photos (~20 profiles) can appear in Online tab without a photo.

ui_bugs.issue: Redo at index == photos.length has no busy indicator (no tile exists for that index), so admin gets no spinner until the poll shows the new photo; clicking again starts nothing visible.

issues: Daily Reward modal pops over the admin dashboard and blocks clicks until dismissed
App bottom-nav (Discover/Likes/...) is shown fixed on the admin page and overlaps the bottom row of photo cards
Many existing persona photos are still the old landmark/travel style (e.g. Charminar, Ganga aarti, forest hike) — admin may want to run Redo/Regenerate
~20 profiles have 0 photos yet show an Approve button

action_items: Validate every_days type in admin_update_story_photos (400 instead of 500)
Add 404 check for profile existence in admin_redo_ai_photo
In get_active_users, cap/mix AI personas so real active users aren't pushed out of limit=20 (e.g. fetch real users first, fill rest with AIs; exclude AI with no photos)
Show a pending placeholder tile for 'Add photo' redo (busy index >= photos.length)
Suppress daily-reward modal and bottom-nav on /admin
critical_code_review_comments: redo_single_photo uses index captured at request time; if admin deletes/reorders photos while a redo is running, the new photo overwrites the wrong slot (or appends). Consider matching by version/value instead of index.
_photo_redo_busy is in-process memory; with multiple workers busy[] is inconsistent (fine for single worker).
server.py is ~12.9k lines; ai_chatbot.py ~2.9k lines — should be split into modules.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Temporary fake PNG photos injected into Priya Sharma (cb373ffe...) and Ananya Patel (4abeebfc...) and restored afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login POST /api/auth/login {email_or_phone,password} -> access_token; UI uses localStorage heartlink_token + user. Dismiss daily-reward-modal before clicking on /admin. Redo took ~40s end-to-end and works (busy listed, version changes, photos_approved false, MAIN follows). post_story_photo verified: prepends new main, caps at 5, sets last_story_photo_at, photos_approved false. Some AI photos are external https URLs (static.prod-images) not /api/photo — that's valid. Run redo test sparingly (costs credits): pytest --deselect ...::TestRedo.
